summary: Fixed TEXT history pagination so prepending an older cursor page preserves the screen position of a visible message and does not regress the read cursor. A test-first widget regression reproduced the visible row being displaced outside the viewport before the fix. No ADB/device was used.

checks.name: TEXT older-page scroll anchor and read-cursor regression
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'preserves the visible text anchor when loading an older page'
checks.observation: The regression first failed on the prior implementation: after loading a page, the previously visible oldest row was no longer built in the viewport. After the fix, that row remains within 1 logical pixel of its original screen coordinate, the new older page is prepended, and the read cursor remains at the newest previously read message.

limitations: Direct-message history does not yet have the same scroll-anchor regression or correction.
Reply navigation across unloaded pages, realtime overlap and live backend cursor behavior remain unverified.
No Android device, ADB, or platform runtime validation was performed.
remaining: Extend and verify the behavior for DM history and test reply, realtime and server-backed read-cursor boundaries; keep physical Android acceptance open.
